text:
Predicates:
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Left(x, y) ::: x left y.
Team(y) ::: y is a team.
Player(x) ::: x is a player.
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
SoccerPlayer(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
Premises:
Striker(x) → SoccerPlayer(x) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
Left(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunchen) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munchen.
∀x ∀y (Left(x, y) → ¬PlaysFor(x, y)) ::: If a player left a team, then they no longer play for that team.
Conclusion:
PlaysFor(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunchen) ::: Robert Lewandowski plays for Bayern Munchen.
